name: GitLab CLI (glab)
description: Installs a pinned glab and authenticates it from Coder external auth on every call, so no token is ever written to disk.

version.description: glab version to install (x.y.z). glab has no permanent 'latest' download URL, so this must be pinned.

host.description: Default GitLab host (GITLAB_HOST) when the caller has not set one.

externalAuthId.description: Coder external auth provider ID to take the token from. Empty disables it (then use GITLAB_TOKEN or `glab auth login`).
